name: std::ranges::zip_transform_view<F,Views...>::iterator<Const>::operator*

declarations.code:
constexpr decltype(auto) operator*() const

    noexcept(/* see description */);

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The element which is the result of transformation (mapping).

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
noexcept specification:  
noexcept(std::invoke(*parent_->fun_, *std::get<INTS>(inner_.current_)...))

where INTS is the pack of integers 0, 1, ..., (sizeof...(Views)-1).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
operator-> is not provided.

The behavior is undefined if the parent_ pointer to parent ranges::zip_transform_view is null (e.g. if *this is default constructed).

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Build a zip_transform_view over the arrays below, read the first item, and move to the next position.

summary: Returns the transformed element obtained by application of the invocable object of type F to the underlying poined-to elements.
